description: SPTS fxP Omega FULL event subscription: every collection event Table 5 documents. Reference only - the active subscription for this profile is generated separately from the mapped subset so unclassified vendor events are not enabled by accident.
_source: Omega_SECSII_SPTS fxP 200mm SECSII Manual (Cimetrix).pdf Table 5, sections 12.5, 12.10 and Appendix G
_manual_note: Table 5 assigns wafer statistical data to CEID 810; Appendix G section 25.3 says the newer Etch step-statistics event is CEID 811. Both are retained because the Rev D manual is internally contradictory and only the vendor can resolve which a specific tool revision emits. Table 5 also links DVID 6503 to CEID 810 without defining or naming DVID 6503 anywhere else in the manual.
